subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella for the reset/phantom-binding/Telegram empty-delivery family, or should maintainers split it across the open runtime and Telegram follow-ups?
rationale: Source inspection confirms one real invariant remains, but the issue also asks for new diagnostics and UX behavior that should be scoped intentionally before automation writes a broad fix.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split fixes
options.body: Use this issue to track the overall failure family, then land narrow PRs for durable binding/self-heal, Telegram fallback, and optional heartbeat or usage metadata decisions.

options.title: Move remaining runtime work to related issues
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87327, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87692, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87744 explicitly own the remaining behavior.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer captures a current Telegram reset/restart repro showing the exact failure mode on main.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split fixes
recommendation.body: Use this issue to track the overall failure family, then land narrow PRs for durable binding/self-heal, Telegram fallback, and optional heartbeat or usage metadata decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent central session lifecycle and compaction changes and merged the current implementation surface.
